ENGLISH ONLY - no Hindi anywhere (slides or caption). Handwritten notebook-page style, 5 pages per post. Every post must be a RANDOM MIX of page types, never the same structure every time: phrasal verbs, idioms, and 'X vs Y' confusing-word/grammar comparisons (e.g. May vs Might, Say vs Tell, Since vs For). Do not repeat any title already used (see used_sentences.json entries for this channel). Word/idiom pages: {title, meaning, synonym, examples[2], tip[1-2]}. Comparison pages: {type:'compare', title:'A vs B', intro, left:{label, examples[2], note}, right:{label, examples[2], note}, tip[1-2]}. In tip lines '->' draws an arrow. Keep meanings short (under ~12 words), examples under ~8 words, comparison-column examples under ~5 words. Examples must be natural, correct English. See posts/phrasalidiomatic/sample-mix/content.json for the exact JSON. ALREADY POSTED on 2026-11-13 (never reuse these titles): Break the ice, Say vs Tell, Run out of, Since vs For, Once in a blue moon. LAYOUTS (use a random mix; vary them across pages and posts): word/idiom page (default type). Comparison pages {type:'compare', layout: one of 'divider' | 'circles' | 'steps' | 'curve', title:'A vs B', intro (optional, short), left:{label, examples[2], note}, right:{...}, tip[...]} - 'steps' suits a weaker->stronger or casual->formal pair (left = lower step), 'curve' and 'circles' suit any pair. Three-way pages {type:'three', title:'A / B / C', intro, columns:[{label, examples[2], note} x3], tip[...]} for sets like In/On/At or This/That/These - examples must be very short (2-4 words). Tip box: optional tip_style 'box' (default) or 'cloud'; optional tip_title 'Tip:' or 'Remember:'. In tip lines '->' draws an arrow, a trailing ' [check]' draws a green tick, ' [star]' draws a green star. Wrap the key word in examples with *asterisks* to underline it in red (e.g. 'Can I *borrow* your pen?'). See posts/phrasalidiomatic/sample-layouts/content.json and sample-mix/content.json for exact JSON. ALSO ALREADY USED as samples (do not post): Give up, Give in, Give away, Give back, Give out, In / On / At (place), Borrow vs Lend, Can I vs May I, Lose vs Loose, Lie vs Lay - except you MAY reuse these sample pages' titles only after 2026-12-31.
